evidence: Single package (packages: 1) with clear module separation (e.g., transcribe.py, diarization.py, writers.py, live.py)
Low directory depth (max 3) indicating flat, cohesive structure without complex distribution across services
Central entry point (whisper_ctranslate2.py) orchestrating core modules (CommandLine, Transcribe, Diarization, Live, Writers)
Strong cohesion within modules (e.g., writers.py contains all output format classes) and low coupling (modules import only specific dependencies)
Test files mirror module structure (testdiarization.py ↔ diarization.py), indicating modular design

risks: Single package may become monolithic over time if new features are added without further modularization
